chunks: As for what al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Jamīl ibn Darrāj, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.
Regarding a man who approached a beast sexually, he said: “He is to be killed.”

key_terms.أَتَى: approached sexually; a euphemistic expression for committing the act
key_terms.بَهِيمَةً: a beast or animal involved in the prohibited act
key_terms.رَجُلٍ: a man; the legal subject mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.يُقْتَلُ: he is to be killed; the prescribed punishment stated in the narration

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Shiʿi hadith on a man who has intercourse with an animal?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام concerning a man who commits intercourse with an animal. The ruling given is capital punishment, reflecting the gravity of the act in Shiʿi jurisprudential discourse.
